key_insight: TopoAgent is an LLM-based agent that automatically selects the most suitable topological descriptor for a medical image dataset and converts topology into usable feature vectors for downstream analysis.
clinical_relevance: This could help medical imaging pipelines capture shape and connectivity information that standard pixel-level models may miss, potentially improving automated analysis of complex images.
method: Uses a Perception–Reasoning–Action–Reflection loop to inspect images and choose topological representations.
Supported by 21 domain-specific tools plus dual memory that accumulates experience across runs.
Learns its descriptor-selection skill from broad benchmarking of 15 descriptors across many datasets and classifiers.
evidence_signal: The framework was distilled from systematic evaluation of 15 topological descriptors across 26 datasets using six classifiers.
watch_item: Performance depends on descriptor selection quality and the added complexity of LLM-agent orchestration, so robustness and generalization should be validated carefully before deployment.
paper_title: TopoAgent: An Agentic Framework for Automated Topology Learning in Medical Imaging
